title: First Unique Character
statement:
Find the first character in a word that never repeats.

Contract
- `word` is non-null and contains only the lowercase letters `a` through `z`.
  The empty word is allowed.
- Return the index of the leftmost character that occurs exactly once in the
  whole word, or `-1` when every character repeats.
- Do not mutate the input.

Examples
- `firstUniqueIndex("leetcode")` returns `0`.
- `firstUniqueIndex("loveleetcode")` returns `2`.
- `firstUniqueIndex("aabb")` returns `-1`.
hints: A character is unique only when you know how often it appears in the whole word, so one left-to-right pass is not enough on its own.
Count how often each letter occurs first, then walk the word again and return the first index whose count is one.
The alphabet has a fixed size, so an int[26] of counts holds everything the second pass needs. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
inputSyntax: Input: one lowercase word, for example: loveleetcode
